The '''chamber of nutrients''' was a room found on the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Desolate]]''. As some parts of the vessel were organic, they required nutrients for power and material conversion; the chamber of nutrients was the ''Desolate''{{'s}} main nutrient processing facility.

The chamber was a large room on the second of four platforms that made up the interior of the ''Desolate''. It was between the [[chamber of armor]] and a living hall. Thick green paste covered the floor, and the room was completely sealed save for two membranous openings. Large translucent tubes throughout the room transported the paste to various ships' systems, and yellow [[floating glob]]s acted as waste removal units.

When a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] made their way through the ''Desolate'' on the hunt for a replacement [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]], they [[Skirmish on the Desolate|battled]] the floating globs inside the chamber of nutrients.
